name: Otago (New Zealand)

colors.symbolism: gold — the rush that built Otago

description: A blue field and a gold zigzag base of mountain peaks, with a gold eight-pointed star above and a blue one below.
history: The Otago flag, chosen by public competition in 2004, shows the region's mountains in gold for the 1860s gold rush; the eight-point stars echo the province's Scottish founding and southern skies.

features.role: one gold star above the peaks, one blue below
